Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This service gets called if the stack initiated a TCP connection before (as client) and the peer (the server) acknowledged the connection set up. In detail: The TCP/ IP stack calls this function after a socket was requested to connect with Tcp Ip_ Tcp Conn ect() and a TCP connection is confirmed by the peer. The parameter value of Socket Id equals the Socket Id value of the preceeding Tcp Ip_ Tcp Connect() call. Available via configurable
